sentence_stem: If you study hard this year,
full_sentence: If you study hard this year, you will pass your exams.
acceptable_variants: you will succeed in your studies.

options.why_wrong: This describes a past event, so it does not give a future result of the condition.

options.text: you have passed your exams before.
options.why_wrong: This describes a past achievement and does not complete the future result expected after 'if'.

options.text: you will be tired all the time.
options.why_wrong: This is a possible future statement, but it is not a logical result of studying hard in the way the stem suggests.

explanation: After 'if' with a present simple verb, English uses 'will' in the main clause to show a likely future result. Turkish speakers may be tempted to put a present form in the main clause, because Turkish marks future meaning with verb suffixes rather than a separate word.
translation: Bu yıl çok çalışırsan sınavlarını geçeceksin.
